New slurm/r_level1_scratch.sh (copy r_level4.sh structure: #SBATCH -A qtim -p rtx8000 --gpus=1 -N 1 --ntasks-per-node=1 --cpus-per-task=3 --mem=128G --time=48:00:00, logs under the project logs folder; env validation; BGR_DRY_RUN; GPU_POLL; checker). Level-1 settings from slurm/r_level1.sh: --level 1, N 8, DEFORM_N 4, TF_MEM_LIMIT_MB 42500, GRAD_CKPT full, PAIR_RECOMPUTE true, LEAN_LOSSES true, MIN_PAIRS n, MAX_PAIRS 64, DEFORM_DECODER_DTYPE float32_fine (flag emitted), VAL_IMAGE_CHUNK 1, VAL_PAIR_CHUNK 1, VAL_GROUP_SIZE empty, d12hs FILTERS/DECODER_WIDTHS, AMP, split group conv, TF intensity aug, LOWRES_METHOD tent, AdamW LR 3e-4 WD 1e-1, cosine, --min-lr-factor 1e-3, GRAD_BALANCE gradnorm. STEPS REQUIRED (die if unset). Schedule defaults from STEPS (integer bash arithmetic): WARMUP STEPS/16, DEFORM_START 3*STEPS/16, DEFORM_RAMP STEPS/32, CURRICULUM_RAMP 3*STEPS/16, G_START 3*STEPS/16, G_RAMP 3*STEPS/16, each overridable; CURRICULUM true; G 45/10. GROUP_CONFIG (default B; A B none E) -> --group-config; NORM (default batch; batch instance) -> --norm only when instance; SMOOTH (default 15) -> --lambda-smooth inside DEFORM_LOSSES (Dice 1/1, LNCC 1/1, p-pdice 0.1). No --cascade-from, no --bn-recal-* flags (BN trains normally). CHECK: --expect-init-weights none, --grad-balance-rule true --grad-balance-from-step DEFORM_START+100, --memory-budget-mb 36864, --max-nonfinite-frac 0.06, --max-window-nonfinite-frac 0.05, --expect-enc-grad true, PROJECT_STEPS/PROJECT_VAL_EVERY. Header: purpose (ablation A1), GPU-hours 63.85 h = sacct 10623341 13:54:14 + 10624169 27:20:44 + 10627751 22:36:02, step rule STEPS = floor(229860 / (mean_step_s + val_pass_s / VAL_EVERY)), smoke + long commands, resume (same RUN_NAME and STEPS), cluster rules.
